AUDIT COMPLETE — root cause identified with evidence. BROKEN LINK: the mrag23 bot PAT in 1Password item hermes-env has NO access to private repo yurifrl/hermes-memory (GitHub 404 = private-repo no-access semantics). Every other link in the chain is healthy. NOT runtime-fixable (GitHub-side ACL grant required) -> blocked.

EVIDENCE PER LINK:
1. ESO->Secret: HEALTHY, no drift. ExternalSecret hermes (ns hermes) SecretSynced; forced resync (annotate force-sync, allowed runtime op) at 2026-09-06T00:12:44Z; Secret hermes-env resourceVersion UNCHANGED (109480945) -> 1Password content == cluster content. GH_TOKEN == GITHUB_TOKEN (single 40-char classic ghp_ token).
2. Token identity: VALID. GET https://api.github.com/user with the secret token -> login=mrag23 id=293488948 (the bot account — expected since the Aug-16 PM close-out where the mrag23 token took over GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN). Scopes: read:org, repo.
3. Token->repo ACL: BROKEN. Token-visible repos = exactly 4: yurifrl/home-systems, yurifrl/Obsidian, yurifrl/hermes-pages, yurifrl/home-systems-values (all push=true). yurifrl/hermes-memory NOT in the set; GET /repos/yurifrl/hermes-memory -> 404 with token AND unauthenticated (repo private, exists for owner only); mrag23/hermes-memory also 404. Corroboration: repos-sync sidecar (0 restarts, Running) syncs exactly those same 4 repos fine with the same token.
4. git-login init container: CORRECT, not the fault. Log: 'Logged in to github.com account mrag23 ... Active account: true' (ghp_ token) + stale inactive yurifrl entry (old fine-grained github_pat_). Live exec gh auth status in repos-sync: active=mrag23 via GH_TOKEN env in every container (envFrom hermes-env); git credential helper = gh auth git-credential -> resolves to the same mrag23 ghp_ token used in the API tests above. Account-selection race from the Aug-16 PM is NOT in play.
5. memory-backup crashloop mechanics: hctl backup clones fresh into emptyDir /backup each restart; clone fails non-fatally (hctl line: _run([git clone ...], check=False)), then _backup_pass -> _write_backup_gitignore -> FileNotFoundError /backup/hermes-memory/.gitignore -> exit 1. The .gitignore error is a downstream symptom, not a cause. Current: hermes-0 3/4, memory-backup CrashLoopBackOff, 1356 restarts over ~5d, exact error 'remote: Repository not found'. The 1356 prior restarts are themselves proof that restart/resync cannot fix an ACL gap.

WHY BLOCKED: fixing requires a GitHub WRITE (grant mrag23 access to yurifrl/hermes-memory, or rotate token) — both forbidden by task guardrails (no 1Password/GitHub writes). No manifest mutations were made; only allowed ops used (ESO force-sync annotation, read-only kubectl get/logs/exec, GitHub API reads).

EXACT USER FIX — Option A (recommended; no token rotation needed):
1. Verify the repo still exists at github.com/yurifrl/hermes-memory (owner-only view). If it was renamed/deleted instead: update memoryBackup.repo/user in home-systems-values repo -> hermes/values.yaml (ArgoCD ships it) and skip to step 4.
2. GitHub -> yurifrl/hermes-memory -> Settings -> Collaborators -> Add people -> mrag23 -> role Write (= Contents R/W for the token).
3. mrag23 must ACCEPT the invite (email/notification, or github.com/yurifrl/hermes-memory/invitations while logged in as mrag23). No secret change is needed — the current token value stays valid.
4. After invite accepted: kubectl -n hermes delete pod hermes-0 (StatefulSet recreates; or just wait <=5m for the next backoff retry) and verify: kubectl -n hermes logs hermes-0 -c memory-backup -f shows clone + sync succeeding and hermes-0 4/4 Running.

EXACT USER FIX — Option B (if you prefer not to share the repo with the bot account):
1. Create a PAT (classic with repo scope, or fine-grained with Contents: Read and write on yurifrl/hermes-memory — remember fine-grained PATs 404 instead of 403 when access is missing, per the Aug-10 PM).
2. Paste into 1Password item hermes-env, fields GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_TOKEN (keep both equal).
3. kubectl -n hermes annotate externalsecret hermes force-sync=1788653941 --overwrite; confirm Secret hermes-env resourceVersion bumps.
4. Restart hermes-0 and verify as in Option A step 4.

RE-CHECKED LIVE with the CURRENT secret (2026-09-06, post-screenshot): STILL 404 — GET https://api.github.com/repos/yurifrl/hermes-memory with a fresh GH_TOKEN extracted from Secret hermes-env -> HTTP 404, no permissions block. Token identity unchanged: /user -> mrag23 id=293488948 (same token as the earlier audit). Forced ESO resync (allowed runtime op): SecretSynced, Secret hermes-env resourceVersion UNCHANGED (109480945) -> 1Password content == cluster content, so the 'Agent' token in the screenshot is either not saved to 1Password or not the value the cluster runs with. Token-visible repos unchanged: yurifrl/home-systems, yurifrl/Obsidian, yurifrl/hermes-pages, yurifrl/home-systems-values. hermes-0 untouched (3/4, memory-backup CrashLoopBackOff). No manifest mutations, no 1Password/GitHub writes — only allowed ops (ESO force-sync annotation, read-only kubectl, GitHub API reads).

ONE-LINE GAP: repo scope ✓ but the token's identity (mrag23) has NO ACCEPTED access grant on yurifrl/hermes-memory — classic 'repo' scope only covers repos its owner account can reach, and even a freshly-added collaborator invite keeps returning 404 until mrag23 ACCEPTS it.

FIX (either, then it self-heals): (A) yurifrl/hermes-memory -> Settings -> Collaborators -> add mrag23 role Write, then log in as mrag23 and ACCEPT the invite (no secret change needed) — or (B) regenerate the token while logged in AS yurifrl (classic, repo scope) and paste into 1Password item hermes-env, fields GH_TOKEN + GITHUB_TOKEN (keep equal), then: kubectl -n hermes annotate externalsecret hermes force-sync=$(date +%s) --overwrite && kubectl -n hermes delete pod hermes-0. Verify: kubectl -n hermes logs hermes-0 -c memory-backup shows clone+push succeeding, hermes-0 4/4 Running. Staying blocked until (A) invite accepted or (B) token rotated.
